title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — 病院と健康 (Hospitals and Health in Japan)
description: From NHK Web やさしい日本語. A practical guide to Japanese healthcare: body parts and symptoms vocabulary, making a clinic appointment, filling in a medical intake form, explaining symptoms to a doctor, understanding a prescription, and using a Japanese pharmacy. Includes key phrases for when you don't feel well.
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
